{"id":1069961190,"question_id":3,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 9 months","timestamp":1696749292,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"69 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1069961190/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters","memory":"39.8 MB","code":"public class Solution {\n    public int LengthOfLongestSubstring(string s) {\n        var charSet = new HashSet<char>();\n        int left = 0, right = 0, maxLength = 0;\n        while(right < s.Length)\n        {\n            if (!charSet.Contains(s[right]))\n            {\n                charSet.Add(s[right]);\n                right++;\n                maxLength = Math.Max(maxLength, charSet.Count);\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                charSet.Remove(s[left]);\n                left++;\n            }\n        }\n        return maxLength;\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-substring-without-repeating-characters","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":158}
